scope: Current Host task schema, compatible row normalization and retained delivery history

paired.method: Actual fixed task schema/history and JSON backend: admission, normalized values, sorted error issue paths/codes, seven persisted v1/read-only/v2-write/cold-read journeys, append retention and cursor pages.

verification.native: 22 passed: task/history cases, seven actual DomainFacility-compatible read/refused write/successful upgrade/reopen flows, immutable records and JSON/domain lifecycle consumers.
verification.source: 47 original storage-evolution, malformed-unit and delivery-history tests passed. Their management/runtime integration portions remain Source-only evidence.

behavior: Explicit targets ignore obsolete Session bindings. Missing destinations reserve deterministic SHA-256 Session identities, including Node-compatible handling of lone UTF-16 surrogates, without allocating or activating a Session.

Normalizes inactive status, legacy receipts and history metadata while preserving existing committed targets. Missing receipt destinations, duplicate history message identities and mismatched latest receipts are refused.

Reads are detached, do not write bytes or synthesize creation timestamps. Actual failed Domain writes retain old bytes and memory; subsequent successful writes stamp v2 and remove the old top-level Session binding.

History pages use exclusive identity cursors and newest-first append order even after clock rollback. Retention appends the sent prompt, applies age/count limits and preserves unavailable/pruned flags; responses copy rows and retention metadata.

cleanup.retained: Commands, hashes, paired values/issue paths, Source result JSON and Native logs/XML/observations. Owned synthetic files, short workspaces and isolated homes removed.

limitations: Finite JSON-shaped schema admission/normalization and issue paths/codes are compared; complete Zod error messages, regex patterns, issue ordering and arbitrary JavaScript values are not claimed.
Management/runtime/tool/application composition and Source-equivalent batch domain deletion remain pending; these modules are not yet production Schedule bindings.
No complete regression, Portable/browser/Win7 acceptance or upstream promotion.
